title: Error cascade from one missing semicolon
compiler_output:
sketch.ino:2:1: error: expected ',' or ';' before 'int'
 int ledPin = 9;
 ^~~
sketch.ino: In function 'void setup()':
sketch.ino:5:11: error: 'ledPin' was not declared in this scope
   pinMode(ledPin, OUTPUT);
           ^~~~~~

exit status 1

reference_context.title: GNU C / ld Documentation
reference_context.snippet: After a syntax error the parser recovers and may report further errors that are consequences of the first one; fix the first error and rebuild.

expected.root_cause: Line 1 is missing a semicolon after `int sensorPin = A0`, so ledPin is never declared and the later errors cascade from it.
expected.fix: Add the semicolon: int sensorPin = A0;
